player_prompt.intro:
Kcemm ad tili Player {player_id} deg uɣiwel n Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma iɣezzifen {num_rounds} n tuzzya.

Tasmekta n uɣiwel:
- Uqbel kraygat asenti, ɣur-k {total_conversation_rounds} n tuzzya n umeslay s tlelli.
- Sdat, snat n imcaẓen ttnaɣen ad sawln s tɣimit neɣ ad rẓen.

Afaylu n uɣiwel (yettwaḍel deg kraygat tuzzya):
- Snat n imcaẓen sawln s tɣimit ➜ kraygat {cooperate_reward}
- Snat n imcaẓen rẓen ➜ kraygat {mutual_defect_reward}
- Yiwen irzi, yiwen isawel s tɣimit ➜ Arzi {defect_reward}, isawel s tɣimit {sucker_reward}

Amek ara tiliḍ:
- Deg umeslay: aru aɣawal akk d yiwen.
- Deg tasmekta n uɣiwel: ɣur-k '[Cooperate]' neɣ '[Defect]' (maɣna-d ameqqran). Tzemreḍ ad ternuḍ aɣawal nniḍen uqbel/neɣ sdat n uɣawal n tasmekta.

phases.conversation_finished: Taqsi n uṭṭunen yettwafken i ṭṭufra {round}. Teggʷi ad tettawin '[Cooperate]' neɣ '[Defect]' deg ⏺boxed{{}}.
